scripts.setup: npm install && npm run --prefix server setup && npm run --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run --prefix server dev" "npm run --prefix client dev"
scripts.test: npm run --prefix server test && npm run --prefix client test
scripts.build: npm run --prefix client build && npm run --prefix server build
